title: 第1342章 星辰破界第1341章 打不过啊
content_zh:
“那怎么办？逃跑吗？再说了，你来这里是为了什么？你走了，祂继续伤害你的子嗣咋整？”小黑无奈问道。
其实不仅仅是吉恩郁闷，小黑更加郁闷，摊上了吉恩这样一个低阶的修士，想要跟松剑这样的敌人斗，实在是千难万难！
就算是加上他也一样无能为力。
平日里，对手没这么强还没啥感觉，都是三下五除二搞定收工，如今遇到松剑这样的对手，明显能感觉到，双方之间有一道鸿沟。
问题是，离开了吉恩，机甲自己又无法发现，精神体状态的敌人。
除非是域外天魔，主动化为实体主动进攻，要不然就算是对方站在这里，小黑也看不到！
如果驾驶探索者机甲的修士，本身境界不够，那机甲的实力也发挥不出多少，能够有个十之一二就不错了。
就像现在，这套机甲的能力，还未使出十分之一！
当～
“得想想办法！嘶～”吉恩缓缓说道。
吉恩尽量将身体放松，让自己能够适应，这样强大的撞击力。
这边吉恩在无力反抗，任松剑施为，他想不到松剑为何如此强大？
另外一边的松剑，也有点怀疑神生了，自己的本命法器，竟然连一个下界人都拿不下？
这不科学！！！
轰隆～
又是一击，吉恩如同破麻袋一般，被打飞到几百米开外。
苏府周边的建筑，几乎没有剩下完好的了。
“星辰.破界！”松剑喝道。
松剑还等着将吉恩击杀，然后将塔玛拉当做自己的据点呢。
毕竟塔玛拉勾连了如此多的星球，可是吉恩虽然在祂的攻击下，被打的毫无还手之力，但自己好像也伤不到对方？

松剑想着，应该是自己的攻击力太低了，虽然不管怎么想都有点难以理解，但祂一时之间也找不到其它办法，只能使用一招大招了！
松剑将星辰.破天剑，遥遥指向天际，浑身的神念夹杂着信仰之力，涌入星辰.破天剑之内。
下一秒，一道磅礴的能量力场，从星辰.破天剑上散逸开来，以松剑如今的神念，无法控制如此庞大的力量。
星辰.破天剑的锋锐，直接刺破了苍穹，空中的云朵也被撕裂了开来，仿佛天空出现了一个大洞。
一道直冲云霄的能量流束，直接展现在世人面前！
松剑神念周围，几十米内各种倒塌的建筑，交通工具、地面，直接开始消融，化作缕缕流光蒸发而起。
原本还在四周躲着吃瓜的群众，直接化作了一缕缕青烟！
更远的，都连滚带爬的向更远处跑去。
自然闻声而来的神殿人员，也纷纷向远处撤离。
“域外天魔果真是域外天魔吗？”吉恩喃喃说道。
这松剑实在是太强了，吉恩根本无法理解！
就算是自己有探索者机甲在身，也奈何不了对方，撑死算是一个合格的沙包吧？
但自己的境界实在是太低了，探索者机甲，可是连仙阶修士都能辅助的！
呜～
呜呜～
仿佛飓风过境，发出令人恐惧的呜咽声，下一秒那道刺破天际的能量柱，直接劈了下来。
轰隆～
content_en:
"Then what should we do? Run away? Besides, why are you here? What if he continues to hurt your heirs after you leave?" Xiao Hei asked helplessly.
In fact, it was not only Jean who was depressed, Xiao Hei was even more depressed. With a low-level monk like Jean, it was really difficult to fight against an enemy like Song Jian!
Even if you add him, there is still nothing you can do.
Normally, when the opponent is not that strong, he doesn't feel anything at all, so he just settles the matter with three strikes, five strikes and divides two. But now when he encounters an opponent like Song Jian, he can clearly feel that there is a gap between the two sides.
The problem is that without Jean, the mecha itself cannot detect the enemy in a mental state.
Unless it is an extraterrestrial demon who takes the initiative to transform into an entity and attack actively, Xiao Hei will not be able to see the opponent even if he is standing here!
If the monk driving the Explorer mecha is not at a high level, then the mecha will not be able to show much of its strength. It would be good to have one or two out of ten.
Just like now, this mecha has not yet used one-tenth of its capabilities!
When ~
"We have to think of a way! Hiss~" Jean said slowly.
Gene tried his best to relax his body so that he could adapt to such a powerful impact.
Gene was unable to resist here and let Song Jian do whatever he wanted. He couldn't imagine why Song Jian was so powerful?
Song Jian on the other side was also a little suspicious of Shensheng. His own magic weapon couldn't even be taken by a person from the lower world?
This is unscientific! ! !
Boom ~
Another blow, and Jean was knocked hundreds of meters away like a broken sack.
There are almost no buildings left intact around the Su Mansion.
"Stars. Break the boundary!" Song Jian shouted.
Song Jian is still waiting to kill Jean and then use Tamara as his stronghold.
After all, Tamara has connected so many planets, but even though Jean was unable to fight back under her attack, it seems that he can't hurt the opponent?
Song Jian thought that his attack power should be too low. Although it was a bit difficult to understand no matter how he thought about it, he could not find any other way for a while and could only use one ultimate move!
Song Jian pointed the Star and Sky-Breaking Sword to the sky in the distance, and all his spiritual thoughts mixed with the power of faith poured into the Star and Sky-Breaking Sword.
The next second, a majestic energy field dispersed from the Star. Breaking Heaven Sword. With Song Jian's current divine will, he was unable to control such a huge power.
The sharpness of the stars and the sky-breaking sword directly pierced the sky, and the clouds in the sky were torn apart, as if a big hole appeared in the sky.
A beam of energy shot straight into the sky, directly displayed in front of the world!
Around Song Jian Shen Nian, various collapsed buildings, vehicles, and the ground within a few dozen meters began to melt, turning into wisps of light and evaporating.
The people who were still hiding around eating melons turned into wisps of smoke!
Those who were further away were rolling and crawling to run further away.
Naturally, the temple personnel who came after hearing the sound also evacuated to a distance.
"Is the Extraterrestrial Demon really the Extraterrestrial Demon?" Jean murmured.
This pine sword is so powerful that Jean can't understand it at all!
Even if he has the Explorer Mecha with him, he can't do anything to the other party. If he can hold himself to death, he is considered a qualified punching bag, right?
But my level is too low. The Explorer mecha can even assist an immortal monk!
Woo~
Woohoo~
It was as if a hurricane was passing by, making a terrifying whimpering sound, and the next second the energy pillar that pierced the sky crashed down.
Boom ~
